Simon Wu

Simon Wu has 7 years of experience in backend and distributed systems. Most
recently, Senior Backend Engineer at Nimbus Analytics (2025-2026), where they
owned the Terraform event pipeline processing 42M events/day. Before that,
Backend Engineer at Windmere Networks (2021-2025). Before that, Software
Engineer I at Sable Digital (2019-2021). Education: B.S. Information Systems,
University of Maryland, 2019. Core skills: PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes,
Node.js, Distributed systems, REST API design, TypeScript, Terraform.
